verdict.rationale: Maritime runs agents, including coding agents like Claude Code, in their own cloud micro-VMs rather than on the developer's machine. Secrets are injected only into that agent's VM, and scoped keys such as computers-only keys limit the blast radius. Together this implies AI-generated code executes off your infrastructure in isolated VMs. However, nothing in the docs presents this as a sandbox for untrusted code or explains its isolation guarantees. Missing for 10: an explicit untrusted-code sandbox/execution API, documented isolation and network-egress controls, ephemeral per-execution environments, and independent or hands-on corroboration of isolation.
